name: Shelfwise
summary: A seven-page stock and sales dashboard with a shop register, for a small shop or cafe
about: A compact seven-page dashboard for a corner shop with a coffee counter. Stock is drawn as jars on shelves that fill to their par level and drain as the register sells, turning amber when an item needs reordering. Coffee drinks use beans and milk from stock, low items become purchase orders in one click, and receiving a delivery tops the shelves back up.
how: On Overview, watch the jars fill, then drain as sales come in; tap a jar to count that item.
Use Register: tap items, add STAFF20 for 20% off, and take cash with change, card or a wallet; a latte also uses beans and milk.
Press Reorder low items to draft one purchase order per supplier, edit the quantities, send it and then receive the delivery.
On Stock, filter by category or Low, count items and edit par levels and reorder points.
Open any ticket in Sales to reprint or refund it, and see the best sellers.
Keep supplier details and lead times in Suppliers; switch the theme or reset the demo in Settings.
